source.author: verg
source.text: Non tu in triviis, indocte, solebas stridenti miserum stipula disperdere carmen?
source.text_original: Non tu in triviis, indocte, solebas / stridenti miserum stipula disperdere carmen?
source.text_english: Was it not you, you ignorant fellow, who used to ruin, with a screeching straw flute, a wretched song at the crossroads?

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Non tu in triviis, indocte, solebas, Stridenti miserum stipula disperdere carmen?
reuse.text_original: Non tu in triviis, indocte, solebas, Stridenti miserum stipula disperdere carmen?
reuse.text_english: Did you not used to, you unlearned man, at the crossroads, ruin my poor song with a rattling straw?
